title: Implement Unity-style CanvasItem selection and dragging
body:
This PR refactors the CanvasItem selection and dragging logic in the editor to behave more consistently with Unity-like interaction, improving usability for users coming from other engines.

**Changes**

- Adjust the selection logic: when an item is already selected, pressing it again does not change the selection immediately.
- Selection switching only happens on mouse up, not on mouse down.
- Repeated clicks cycle selection upward through overlapping CanvasItems, similar to Unity’s hierarchy selection.

Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14688
